title: vicia glauca subsp. giennensis
intro: Vicia glauca subsp. giennensis, commonly known as blue vetch, is a plant species belonging to the legume family and is native to the Iberian Peninsula. The health benefits of blue vetch include its potential use in treating various ailments, such as digestive issues and infections, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Vicia glauca subsp. giennensis include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of blue vetch include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
